caseName: Iowa ex rel. Miller v. Lyng
caseNameFull: Iowa ex rel. Miller, Attorney General of Iowa v. Lyng, Secretary of Agriculture and Lyng, Secretary of Agriculture v. Iowa ex rel. Miller, Attorney General of Iowa

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Justice White and Justice Blackmun would grant certiorari. Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.
